phrases.title: 因果
phrases.phraseEn: The rapid development of technology has fundamentally changed the way people communicate and access information.
phrases.meaningZh: 技术的快速发展从根本上改变了人们交流和获取信息的方式。

phrases.title: 对比
phrases.phraseEn: While some argue that economic growth should take priority, others insist that environmental protection cannot be compromised.
phrases.meaningZh: 有人认为经济增长应优先，也有人坚持环境保护不可妥协。

phrases.title: 观点
phrases.phraseEn: It is widely acknowledged that a well-rounded education should cultivate critical thinking rather than rote memorization alone.
phrases.meaningZh: 人们普遍认为，全面的教育应培养批判性思维，而不仅仅是死记硬背。

phrases.title: 现象
phrases.phraseEn: An increasing number of graduates are choosing to start their own businesses instead of seeking traditional employment.
phrases.meaningZh: 越来越多的毕业生选择创业，而不是寻找传统就业。

phrases.title: 建议
phrases.phraseEn: Governments are urged to invest more in public health infrastructure so that societies can respond more effectively to future crises.
phrases.meaningZh: 人们呼吁政府加大对公共卫生基础设施的投资，以便社会能更有效地应对未来的危机。

phrases.title: 数据
phrases.phraseEn: According to recent surveys, nearly two thirds of urban residents spend at least two hours a day on mobile devices.
phrases.meaningZh: 根据近期调查，近三分之二的城市居民每天至少花两小时在移动设备上。

phrases.title: 转折
phrases.phraseEn: The policy was designed to reduce inequality; however, its implementation has met with unexpected resistance.
phrases.meaningZh: 该政策旨在减少不平等，但其实施却遇到了意想不到的阻力。

phrases.title: 举例
phrases.phraseEn: Take renewable energy as an example: solar and wind power have become far more affordable over the past decade.
phrases.meaningZh: 以可再生能源为例：过去十年里，太阳能和风能的成本已大幅下降。

phrases.title: 结论
phrases.phraseEn: In conclusion, sustainable development requires a balance between economic progress and ecological responsibility.
phrases.meaningZh: 总之，可持续发展需要在经济进步与生态责任之间取得平衡。

phrases.title: 态度
phrases.phraseEn: Researchers remain cautious about drawing definitive conclusions from a single experiment.
phrases.meaningZh: 研究人员对仅凭一次实验就得出定论仍持谨慎态度。

phrases.title: 比较
phrases.phraseEn: Compared with previous generations, today's students have greater access to online learning resources.
phrases.meaningZh: 与前几代人相比，当今学生能更方便地获取在线学习资源。

phrases.title: 原因
phrases.phraseEn: One possible explanation for this trend is that remote work has reduced the need for daily commuting.
phrases.meaningZh: 对这一趋势的一种可能解释是，远程办公减少了对日常通勤的需求。

phrases.title: 影响
phrases.phraseEn: The spread of misinformation on social media can undermine public trust in scientific institutions.
phrases.meaningZh: 社交媒体上错误信息的传播会削弱公众对科学机构的信任。

phrases.title: 措施
phrases.phraseEn: Schools have introduced stricter regulations to prevent academic dishonesty in online examinations.
phrases.meaningZh: 学校出台了更严格的规定，以防止在线考试中的学术不端行为。

phrases.title: 预测
phrases.phraseEn: Experts predict that artificial intelligence will reshape many professions within the next twenty years.
phrases.meaningZh: 专家预测，人工智能将在未来二十年内重塑许多职业。

phrases.title: 价值
phrases.phraseEn: Cultural heritage should be preserved not only for tourism but also for the identity of local communities.
phrases.meaningZh: 文化遗产不仅应为了旅游而保护，也应为了当地社区的身份认同。

phrases.title: 挑战
phrases.phraseEn: Despite remarkable advances in medicine, access to affordable healthcare remains a challenge in many regions.
phrases.meaningZh: 尽管医学取得了显著进步，在许多地区，获得可负担的医疗保健仍是一项挑战。

phrases.title: 合作
phrases.phraseEn: International cooperation is essential if we hope to address climate change on a global scale.
phrases.meaningZh: 若希望在全球范围内应对气候变化，国际合作至关重要。

phrases.title: 习惯
phrases.phraseEn: Forming a habit of reading English materials every day can significantly improve vocabulary retention.
phrases.meaningZh: 养成每天阅读英语材料的习惯，能显著提高词汇记忆效果。

phrases.title: 阅读·教育
phrases.phraseEn: Universities are under pressure to demonstrate that their graduates possess skills valued by employers. Critics claim that too many courses emphasize theory at the expense of practical training. Supporters counter that a broad liberal education prepares students to adapt to careers that may not yet exist. The debate reflects deeper questions about the purpose of higher education in a changing economy.
phrases.meaningZh: 大学面临压力，须证明毕业生具备雇主看重的技能。批评者称过多课程重理论轻实践；支持者则认为通识教育能让学生适应尚未出现的职业。这场争论反映出在变化的经济中高等教育目的这一更深问题。

phrases.title: 阅读·科技
phrases.phraseEn: Automation has eliminated some routine jobs while creating demand for workers who can design, maintain, and collaborate with intelligent systems. Policymakers debate whether retraining programs are sufficient to help displaced workers transition into new roles. Without timely investment in education and social safety nets, technological progress risks widening the gap between skilled and unskilled labor.
phrases.meaningZh: 自动化淘汰了一些常规岗位，同时增加了对能设计、维护并与智能系统协作人才的需求。政策制定者争论再培训是否足以帮助失业者转型。若不及时投资教育和社会保障，技术进步可能扩大高技能与低技能劳动者之间的差距。

phrases.title: 阅读·环境
phrases.phraseEn: Plastic waste accumulating in oceans threatens marine ecosystems and eventually enters the human food chain. Some countries have banned single-use plastics, while others rely on recycling campaigns. Environmentalists argue that reducing consumption at the source is more effective than cleaning up pollution after it occurs. Consumers, manufacturers, and governments must share responsibility for lasting change.
phrases.meaningZh: 海洋中积累的塑料垃圾威胁海洋生态系统，并最终进入人类食物链。一些国家禁止一次性塑料，另一些则依靠回收宣传。环保人士认为，从源头减少消费比事后清理更有效。消费者、制造商和政府须共同承担持久改变的责任。

phrases.title: 阅读·健康
phrases.phraseEn: Regular physical activity is associated with lower risks of heart disease, diabetes, and depression. Yet modern lifestyles often involve long hours of sitting in offices or in front of screens. Public health campaigns encourage walking, cycling, and brief exercise breaks during the workday. Small changes in daily habits can produce measurable benefits over time.
phrases.meaningZh: 规律运动与较低的心脏病、糖尿病和抑郁风险相关。但现代生活方式常意味着长时间坐在办公室或屏幕前。公共卫生运动鼓励步行、骑行及工作间隙短暂锻炼。日常习惯的小改变长期可带来可衡量的益处。

phrases.title: 阅读·城市
phrases.phraseEn: Urbanization has lifted millions out of poverty but also strained housing, transportation, and air quality in megacities. Planners experiment with green buildings, expanded public transit, and mixed-use neighborhoods that reduce commuting distances. Successful cities balance growth with livability, ensuring that newcomers can find affordable places to live and work.
phrases.meaningZh: 城市化使数百万人脱贫，但也给特大城市的住房、交通和空气质量带来压力。规划者试验绿色建筑、扩大公共交通及减少通勤的混合功能区。成功的城市在增长与宜居之间取得平衡，确保新来者能找到负担得起的居住与工作之所。

phrases.title: 阅读·文化
phrases.phraseEn: Global streaming platforms expose audiences to films and music from many countries, blurring traditional cultural boundaries. Some artists welcome this exposure, while others worry that local traditions may be overshadowed by dominant languages and genres. Cultural exchange can enrich creativity when it is mutual rather than one-directional.
phrases.meaningZh: 全球流媒体平台让观众接触多国影视音乐，模糊了传统文化边界。一些艺术家欢迎这种曝光，另一些则担心本土传统被强势语言与类型掩盖。当文化交流是相互而非单向时，能丰富创造力。

phrases.title: 阅读·心理
phrases.phraseEn: Chronic stress can impair memory, sleep, and immune function. Psychologists recommend techniques such as mindfulness, structured routines, and social support to manage pressure during exam periods or career transitions. Recognizing early signs of burnout allows individuals to seek help before problems become severe.
phrases.meaningZh: 慢性压力会损害记忆、睡眠和免疫功能。心理学家建议在考试期或职业转型期间用正念、规律作息和社会支持来管理压力。及早识别倦怠迹象，可在问题严重前寻求帮助。

phrases.title: 阅读·经济
phrases.phraseEn: Inflation erodes purchasing power when wages do not keep pace with rising prices. Central banks may raise interest rates to cool demand, but such measures can slow investment and employment. Economists study historical episodes to design policies that stabilize prices without triggering prolonged recessions.
phrases.meaningZh: 当工资跟不上物价上涨时，通胀会侵蚀购买力。央行可能加息以抑制需求，但这会放缓投资与就业。经济学家研究历史案例，以设计既能稳定物价又不引发长期衰退的政策。

phrases.title: 阅读·科学
phrases.phraseEn: Peer review remains the cornerstone of scientific publishing, though it is not immune to bias or delay. Open-access journals have made research findings more widely available, accelerating collaboration across borders. Reproducibility—the ability of other labs to obtain similar results—is now emphasized as a measure of reliability.
phrases.meaningZh: 同行评议仍是科学出版的基石，尽管难免偏见与拖延。开放获取期刊使研究成果更易获取，加速跨国合作。可重复性——其他实验室能否得到类似结果——现被强调为可靠性的衡量标准。

phrases.title: 阅读·媒体
phrases.phraseEn: Algorithms curate news feeds based on users' past clicks, which can create echo chambers where people rarely encounter opposing views. Media literacy education teaches students to verify sources, distinguish opinion from fact, and recognize emotional manipulation in headlines. An informed public is vital for democratic debate.
phrases.meaningZh: 算法根据用户过往点击推荐新闻，可能形成回音室，使人很少接触对立观点。媒介素养教育教学生核实来源、区分观点与事实、识别标题中的情绪操纵。知情的公众对民主辩论至关重要。

phrases.title: 阅读·历史
phrases.phraseEn: Historians reinterpret past events as new archives are discovered and social values evolve. What was once presented as inevitable progress may later be understood as the result of contested choices by individuals and institutions. Studying history encourages humility about the present and caution about simple explanations.
phrases.meaningZh: 随着新档案发现与社会价值观演变，历史学家会重新解读过去。曾被叙述为必然进步之事，后来可能被理解为个人与机构相互角力的选择结果。学习历史使人对当下保持谦逊，对简单解释保持警惕。
